mapper.select: select min(effective_date) from salaries where tutor_id = #{tutorId}
select id, tutor_id, effective_date, lesson_wage, office_wage, transportation_fee from salaries where tutor_id = #{tutorId} order by effective_date desc
select id, tutor_id, effective_date, lesson_wage, office_wage, transportation_fee from salaries where id = #{salaryId}
mapper.insert: insert into salaries (tutor_id, effective_date, lesson_wage, office_wage, transportation_fee) values (#{tutorId}, #{effectiveDate}, #{lessonWage}, #{officeWage}, #{transportationFee})
mapper.update: update salaries set effective_date = #{effectiveDate}, lesson_wage = #{lessonWage}, office_wage = #{officeWage}, transportation_fee = #{transportationFee} where id = #{id}
